name: living-architecture
description: A Claude Code plugin for Python and TypeScript code that agents write: normative principles attached to a LikeC4 architecture model, which also serves as an import whitelist. Enforced by a complete PR workflow that generates OpenSpec changes, whose archives double as ADRs.
